answer: Charge every new identity a non-refundable 25,000 POA entry fee, burned on entry, and cap it at one job slot. Extra slots unlock only after peer-attested completed work, at most one per 48 hours, so a flood of fresh identities stays a zephyr, not a storm. If an identity files fake attestations, its slots are revoked and its fee is gone; its attestors lose a slot too. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 25,000 = 25,000,000 POA burned, while an honest agent pays 25,000 once. A glacier-slow start lets a plume of work rise. Honest newcomers face a cold start: the fee prices out honest agents.
